examples.en: However, as Amy Edmondson of Harvard points out, organizations increasingly use "team" as a verb rather than a noun: they form teams for specific purposes and then quickly disband them.
examples.zh: 然而，正如哈佛大学的艾米·埃德蒙森所指出的那样，越来越多的组织将“团队”用作动词而非名词，原因是他们往往为了一些特殊目的组建团队，之后迅速地又解散团队。

examples.en: His solicitor, Eddie Parladorio, said on Tuesday: "I can confirm Mr Edmondson was arrested today."
examples.zh: 他的私人律师艾德·帕拉多·里奥周二表示：“我可以证实埃德蒙先生今日被捕。”

examples.en: Mr Edmondson was sacked by the News of the World in January after evidence emerged linking him to hacking claims.
examples.zh: 在黑客指控证据确凿后，埃德蒙森在2月被《世界新闻》解雇。
